files.doc.yml:
effects:
  - type: prompt
    name: greet
    template: 'Hello, {{input.name}}!'

effects:
  - type: prompt
    name: chat
    messages:
      - role: system
        content: 'You are helpful.'
      - role: user
        content: 'Hi {{input.name}}'

effects:
  - type: prompt
    name: extract
    template: 'Extract JSON'
    prompt_type: json
    schema:
      type: object

effects:
  - type: tool
    name: fetch
    provider: shell
    params:
      cmd: 'echo {{input.name}}'
      allowed_commands: ['echo']
    retries:
      max_attempts: 3
      backoff_ms: 500
    expect: 'value.ok == true'

effects:
  - type: tool
    name: fetch
    provider: shell
    params:
      count: {from: 'input.n', default: 1}

effects:
  - type: use
    name: sub
    path: child.yml
    inputs:
      topic: '{{input.topic}}'
    outputs:
      result: {path: 'prime.sub.value'}

effects:
  - type: use
    name: sub
    inline: 'effects: []'

effects:
  - type: yield
    name: out
    template: 'Value is {{input.n}}'

effects:
  - type: reflector
    name: think
    effects:
      - type: prompt
        name: propose_steps
        template: 'propose'

effects:
  - type: dynamic
    name: group
    flow: tree
    effects:
      - type: prompt
        name: a
        template: 'a'
      - type: prompt
        name: b
        template: 'b'
    finally:
      - type: prompt
        name: cleanup
        template: 'done'

effects:
  - type: if
    name: branch
    if:
      mode: cel
      expr: 'state.input.ok == true'
    then:
      - type: prompt
        name: yes_branch
        template: 'yes'
    else:
      - type: prompt
        name: no_branch
        template: 'no'
